sections.Profile:
"Riviera" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in July 1973. The game features a casino theme, with artwork by Christian Marche depicting showgirls, bands, slot machines, and roulette tables. The playfield is equipped with four flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, two rollover buttons, and a kick-out hole

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
